headline: Full Stack Developer
summary: I am Gilbert Mugabe, a Full Stack Developer focused on designing and delivering reliable digital products. I build innovative, scalable applications that solve real business problems.
biography: I work across both frontend and backend development, using React, Redux, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to build responsive user interfaces, and Node.js, Express, NestJS, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL to deliver reliable server-side systems.
details: I work across both frontend and backend development, using React, Redux, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to build responsive user interfaces, and Node.js, Express, NestJS, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL to deliver reliable server-side systems.
I hold a Bachelor of Computer Engineering with Honours from the University of Rwanda (2021–2025), which provided a strong foundation in software engineering principles.
From October 2023 to March 2024, I completed the CSR Technical Program, where I strengthened my skills in modern software practices and confirmed my path as a Full Stack Engineer.

Most recently, I worked at FHR Rwanda as a Frontend Developer, building scalable financial management tools with Next.js, JavaScript, and Ant Design. I also interned at MTN Rwanda as a Software Developer, where I built a Y'ello Care system using Spring Boot, Java, and PostgreSQL.
homeTagline: Driven software engineer committed to building innovative, scalable solutions that power seamless digital experiences.
homeDescription: Versatile and results-driven Full Stack Software Engineer with a proven track record of delivering robust, scalable, and innovative solutions across the software development lifecycle. Adept at leveraging both front-end and back-end technologies to create seamless, high-performance applications. Passionate about solving complex challenges through clean code, thoughtful architecture, and user-centric design.
